audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Quinn five of seven stages against a 53.0% Camille win rate over 632 games, and it contradicts its own page: spikes[1] 'you own short trades', spikes[2] 'Hextech Ultimatum is the lane-winner', mid 'this is your takeover', whys[2]/[3]/[5] all describe Camille winning levels 3 through first item. Only levels 1-2 and the two-item stage are defensibly hers.
audit.why: 53.0% over 632 games with the page's own prose describing a level-3 takeover cannot coexist with a chart that gives Quinn levels 3-5 and level 6. I could not propose the flips: 'Quinn' is 5 characters and 'Camille' is 7, outside the applier's +/-10% band for win[]/side fields.
audit.corrected: Left every row untouched rather than half-fix it, and raised it in questionsForUser for a hand fix or mirror-fix.js.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Keep diving on her Vault cooldown' and 'when her Vault is on cooldown' are the trigger for every commit on the page, and Vault's cooldown never appears. Heightened Senses never appears at all despite being the ability that spots your wall approach.
audit.why: Blinding Assault 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, Heightened Senses 50/45/40/35/30s, Vault 12/11/10/9/8s, Behind Enemy Lines recasts on 3s. The 12s on Vault at rank 1 is the dive window; Heightened Senses' 50s reveal is why a flanking Camille sometimes gets seen coming.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, early, mid and whys[3] now carry Vault's 12s and name Heightened Senses as her scouting tool.

audit.whatIsWrong: One fabricated mechanic and two big omissions. (1) 'Marks you with Vulnerability' appears twice - Vault applies no such mark. It damages, SLOWS, and briefly INTERRUPTS the target before she leaps off; the marking is Harrier, her passive. The interrupt is the real reason it breaks your engage, and it was never named. (2) Blinding Assault hinders your vision, and Camille's entire damage pattern - Precision Protocol, her autos, and the bonus magic damage on her R attacks - runs through basic attacks. A blind blanks all of it, and the ability appears nowhere on the page. (3) Behind Enemy Lines is a CHANNEL, so your Hookshot knock-up cancels her ult outright.
audit.why: Riot, Vault: 'Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her.' Blinding Assault: 'Quinn calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision before damaging all enemies in the immediate area.' Behind Enemy Lines: 'Quinn and Valor team up to fly around at great speed.' _missing-interactions.json flags channel-interruptible: 'Quinn's Behind Enemy Lines (R) is a channel — your Hookshot (E) cancels it outright.'
audit.corrected: early, wants.foe[0] and whys[1] replace the invented Vulnerability mark with the slow-and-interrupt Vault actually does; spikes[0].text and mid add the Blinding Assault vision hinder; late adds the Hookshot cancel on her ult channel.

edits.after: Quinn's window: Harrier marks you so her first attack hits harder, and Blinding Assault (Q, 11s) hinders your vision — which blanks the basic attacks your whole kit runs on. Soak minimal chip and farm.

edits.before: Level 1 is hers — Quinn's range plus her Harrier passive (which marks you for bonus on-hit damage) let her auto-poke you for free before you have any all-in tool, so don't walk up to trade autos you can't win. The thing to respect is her E Vault: she dashes in, marks you with Vulnerability and knocks herself back to safety, so if she Vaults as you E in she can blow your engage and reset spacing. Farm with your Q and accept a little chip; once you hit 3 with Q, W and a point in E, the trade math flips hard in your favor.
edits.after: Level 1 is hers — Quinn's range plus Harrier, which marks you so her first attack hits harder, lets her poke you for free before you have an all-in, so don't trade autos you can't win. Respect Vault (E, 12s): she dashes in, slows you, briefly INTERRUPTS whatever you were doing and knocks herself back to safety, so a Vault into your E blows the engage. Respect Blinding Assault too — hindered vision blanks the attacks your kit runs on. Farm with Q; at 3 the trade math flips.

edits.before: This is your takeover. From level 3 you out-trade her short-range poke: E off a wall or onto her to stun, Q-recast for the empowered second hit and its true damage, W's outer cone to slow her kite and heal yourself off the hit. The move speed from re-casting Q lets you stick to her through her Harrier nimbleness. At 6 your R answers everything she does — lock her in the Hextech arena and she cannot Vault away or kite, so her whole ranged advantage evaporates and you win the isolated 1v1.
edits.after: This is your takeover. From level 3 you out-trade her poke: E off a wall for the knock-up, Q-recast for the true-damage second hit, W's outer cone to slow her kite and heal yourself. The move speed off the Q re-cast lets you stick to her. Watch Heightened Senses (W, 50s) — that reveal is how she sees a wall flank coming. At 6 your R answers everything she does: locked in the Hextech arena she cannot Vault away or kite, her whole ranged advantage evaporates, and you win the isolated 1v1.

edits.before: Win the lane before full builds matter. With IE and Phantom Dancer, Quinn becomes a high-mobility ranged carry who pokes and bursts you from range on the open map and Vaults out of your E to peel your all-in. Your tempo and pick threat peak in the early-to-mid window — snowball this lead into kills elsewhere and take towers, because if the game drags to her item spikes she reclaims the spacing your R can't always force in a sprawling teamfight.
edits.after: Win the lane before full builds matter. With IE and Phantom Dancer, Quinn becomes a high-mobility ranged carry who bursts you from range and Vaults out of your E to peel your all-in. One tool stays yours all game: Behind Enemy Lines is a channel, so your Hookshot knock-up drops her out of it. Your tempo and pick threat peak early-to-mid — snowball this lead into kills elsewhere and take towers before her item spikes reclaim the spacing.

notes: 'Marks you with Vulnerability' is a mechanic Quinn does not have; it appears twice and it hides the thing that actually beats you, which is that Vault briefly INTERRUPTS its target - that is why Vaulting into your engage cancels it, and the page never says so. The bigger omission is Blinding Assault: it hinders vision, and every point of Camille's damage runs through basic attacks (Precision Protocol, her autos, and the bonus magic damage her R adds to attacks), so a blind turns off her whole kit. The ability was not mentioned once in either layer. Behind Enemy Lines being a channel your Hookshot cancels is also new to the page. CHART CONTRADICTION: five of seven stages go to Quinn in a 53.0% matchup whose own prose calls level 3 onward a Camille takeover; 'Quinn' (5) to 'Camille' (7) is outside the applier's band, so it needs a hand fix.
